decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Heritage Statement Received: 23 December 2011 Proposed Layout and Elevations - Drawing No: B764-NLPB-20084 Rev. C Received: 08 March 2012 Internal Lobby Cage Details & Door sets and locking mechanisms - Drawing No: P312722-06 Rev. C Received: 08 March 2012 Window Bar W01 - Drawing No: P312722-07 Rev. D Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W02 - Drawing No: P312722-08 Rev. D Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W03, W06 & W07 - Drawing No: P312722-09 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W04, W05 & W08 - Drawing No: P312722-10 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Anti - Climb Quadrants - Drawing No: P312722-15 Rev. B Received: 03 April 2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Listed building works incorporating: Erection of eight internal window bar sets; internal lobby cage with door sets and locking mechanisms and four anti-climb quadrant frames around the Primary Filter House
